title: Scenarij 2: procurjela tajna i zloupotreba AWS-a
summary: AWS ključ procuri kroz git istoriju i javni CI log, a sedam dana kasnije napadač ga koristi: enumeracija, eskalacija kroz CreatePolicyVersion, novi korisnik i ključevi, preuzimanje podataka iz S3 i pokušaj gašenja CloudTraila. Pratiš ga gitleaksom i jq-om kroz CloudTrail, procjenjuješ štetu, obuzdavaš deny politikom i pišeš Sigma detekciju i izvještaj.
title_en: Scenario 2: a leaked secret and AWS abuse
summary_en: An AWS key leaks through git history and a public CI log, and seven days later an attacker uses it: enumeration, escalation via CreatePolicyVersion, a new user and keys, data theft from S3 and an attempt to stop CloudTrail. You follow the attacker with gitleaks and jq through CloudTrail, assess the damage, contain with a deny policy, and write a Sigma detection and a report.
